blocks.text: The sky keeps its gifts for those who carry a little of it. A plain sword kills a bat; a sword touched by winged energy kills a bat and keeps its membrane.

Open the Forge Bench and choose its Winged Energy tab. Place any item in the slot and click Imbue. Click Cleanse to take the energy back. It costs nothing and works on anything: a pickaxe, a sword, a fishing rod, even a stair block if you fancy killing with it.
An imbued item shines like an enchanted one and carries a Winged Energy line in its tooltip. It is not an enchantment, so anvils, grindstones and enchanting tables leave it alone.

Mobs: the item in your main hand when the mob dies must be imbued. Blocks: the tool that breaks the block must be imbued. Fishing: the rod must be imbued, and a winged catch comes on top of the usual one.
Each drop has a source, a chance and sometimes a condition: a biome, the time of day, the weather, a height, a structure, the light level, or whether you were sneaking or sprinting.

A few examples. Bats drop a Bat Membrane half of the time. Rabbits give Hushed Down only at night, to a hunter who sneaks. Goats give a Raptor Talon when slain above Y 120. Fully grown wheat hides Crow Feathers. Fishing from a beach brings up Gull Feathers. The Ender Dragon sheds twelve Dragon Scales.
Common drops are everywhere too: Supple Hide from cows and horses, Silk Thread from spiders, Sky Iron Fleck from iron ore, and many more. Each item's riddle tells where to look.
